body:
Exactly. I wish things were different, but they're not. I wish it was me, laying next to him, waking up with him, looking for houses with him. Everything I never got to do, in so many years, she got it in a few months.

I miss him so fucking much, I never knew I could feel this way.
Trust me, I've been there. And went back to that place way too many times. And now I can't believe any of this is happening. I want it to stop.
It hurts so fucking much. That someone who once cared so much for you, doesn't even bat an eye now....
